schools.name: Kelley School of Business
schools.description: The Kelley School of Business at Indiana University is consistently ranked among the top business schools in the U.S., celebrated for its rigorous academics, strong career outcomes, and collaborative culture. The Full-Time MBA program emphasizes experiential learning through consulting projects, brand management immersions, and domestic treks, preparing graduates for leadership roles across industries. Kelley is particularly renowned for its consulting and finance placements, with over 90% of students receiving merit-based scholarships.

curriculum.year1: First year focuses on a rigorous core curriculum covering economics, business law, organizational behavior, operational management, marketing management, financial management, digital technology innovation, and strategic capabilities. The core is structured in three progressive blocks: Foundations, Functions, and Future.
curriculum.year2: Second year offers 24 credits of electives to personalize the MBA across seven majors including Business Analytics, Entrepreneurship & Innovation, Finance, Global Supply Chain Management, Information Technology Management, Marketing, and Strategic Management. Students may pursue dual degrees, global immersions, and domestic treks.

learningMethods.name: Consulting Projects
learningMethods.description: Students engage in real-world consulting engagements with companies as part of the experiential learning curriculum.

learningMethods.name: Brand Management Immersion
learningMethods.description: Hands-on brand management experience working with nationally distributed consumer products.

learningMethods.name: Washington DC Trek
learningMethods.description: Intensive week of networking and education in Washington, DC, connecting students to policy and business leaders.

studentLife.location: Located in Bloomington, Indiana, a vibrant college town offering a high quality of life with arts, outdoor activities, and a close-knit MBA community on a beautiful residential campus.

schools.name: Simon Business School
schools.description: Simon Business School at the University of Rochester is a rigorous, analytically driven MBA program known for its economics-based curriculum, STEM designation, and strong focus on finance, technology, and consulting. The school's small cohort size fosters an intimate learning environment with exceptional faculty access and personalized career support. Simon is particularly noted for its flexible curriculum with 10 career-focused concentrations spanning finance, marketing, and consulting tracks.

curriculum.year1: Year one is anchored by nine required core courses covering economics, accounting, finance, marketing, operations, strategy, and statistics, along with a Communicating Business Decisions sequence and a client-facing project aligned with career interests. Students can begin electives in the first year to accelerate specialization.
curriculum.year2: Year two focuses on electives and two required breadth courses covering professional skills such as leadership, ethics, negotiation, and organizational behavior. Students choose from 10 concentrations across Finance, Marketing, and Consulting tracks, including Asset Management, Banking, Corporate Finance, Venture Capital & Private Equity, Brand Management, Product Management, Operations, Pricing, Strategy, and Technology.

learningMethods.name: Client Projects
learningMethods.description: Students work on real client-facing projects aligned with their career interests, integrating academic learning with practical problem-solving.

learningMethods.name: International Immersions
learningMethods.description: Global treks and international immersion experiences that expose students to business environments outside the United States.

learningMethods.name: STEM MBA Designation

schools.name: Scheller College of Business
schools.description: Georgia Tech's Scheller College of Business delivers a distinctive MBA experience that merges rigorous business fundamentals with Georgia Tech's world-class engineering and technology ecosystem. The Full-Time MBA program is STEM-designated and particularly strong in analytics, consulting, technology, and sustainability, with 14 concentration options and extensive access to Atlanta's booming business community. Scheller is known for producing analytically sophisticated graduates who command strong outcomes in top consulting and technology firms.

curriculum.year1: Year one consists of 12 required core courses (21 credit hours) covering accounting, finance, economics, marketing, operations, strategy, organizational behavior, and business law. The compressed core is sequenced to build essential skills quickly, and students can begin electives in the first year to prepare for summer internships.
curriculum.year2: Year two focuses primarily on 11 elective courses (33 credit hours) and allows students to complete one required concentration from 14 STEM-designated options: accounting, business analytics, entrepreneurship, finance, international business, leadership, management of information resources, marketing, supply chain & operations, product & service innovation, strategy & innovation, sustainability, and TI:GER.

learningMethods.name: Practicum Courses
learningMethods.description: 10 practicum course options allow students to apply academic theory to real-world business challenges with industry partners.

learningMethods.name: TI:GER Program
learningMethods.description: A 12-month transdisciplinary program where MBA students collaborate with Georgia Tech PhD students from Engineering, Computing, and Sciences on commercializing innovative technology.

centers.name: Ray C. Anderson Center for Sustainable Business

schools.name: Mendoza College of Business
schools.description: The Mendoza College of Business at the University of Notre Dame offers a values-driven MBA education that integrates rigorous business training with ethical leadership development and a strong sense of community. Mendoza's MBA is known for its intimate cohort environment, collaborative culture, and exceptional alumni network, producing graduates who are highly sought after in finance, consulting, and corporate roles. The program's tradition of integrity and service distinguishes it as one of the most values-focused MBA programs in the country.

curriculum.year1: First year covers core business disciplines across four semesters structured in two seven-week modules per semester, including analytics, strategy, finance, marketing, operations, and leadership. Students begin selecting concentration tracks toward the end of the first year.
curriculum.year2: Second year focuses on electives and experiential learning in one of nine concentrations: business analytics, business leadership, corporate finance, digital marketing & marketing analytics, innovation & entrepreneurship, investments, marketing, strategy, and supply chain & operations management.

schools.name: Fisher College of Business
schools.description: The Max M. Fisher College of Business at The Ohio State University offers a highly ranked Full-Time MBA program known for its rigorous academics, strong career outcomes, and tight-knit cohort of approximately 100 students. Fisher leverages Columbus's growing tech and corporate hub, with exceptional strengths in finance, consulting, and supply chain management. The program is distinguished by its Career & Industry Immersion Academies, Global Applied Projects, and generous merit-based funding that supports 75% of incoming students.

curriculum.year1: Year one focuses on the 27-credit core curriculum covering finance, marketing, accounting, operations, strategy, and leadership, with team projects, professional development workshops, and Career & Industry Immersion Academy excursions. Students complete a Business Lab Project consulting engagement for a local firm.
curriculum.year2: Year two provides 27 elective credits and 6 experiential learning credits for specialization. Students assume leadership roles in student organizations and pursue optional specialization pathways through Career and Industry Immersion Academies in Marketing, Finance, Strategy & Consulting, Operations & Analytics, and Supply Chain.

schools.name: Wisconsin School of Business
schools.description: The Wisconsin School of Business Full-Time MBA is a specialized, career-focused program at the University of Wisconsin-Madison that allows students to concentrate in their chosen field from the first semester. The program integrates a rigorous general management core with hands-on, team-focused experiential learning tied to career specializations in areas such as finance, marketing, supply chain, consulting, and more. With 99% of students receiving merit aid and a strong placement track record, Wisconsin delivers outstanding value and career outcomes.

curriculum.year1: The first year establishes a general management core that integrates key functional areas of business with essential leadership skills. Students begin specializing in their chosen career track from the first semester, gaining robust, team-focused, hands-on project and consulting experience tailored to their field.
curriculum.year2: Second-year students deepen their specialization through advanced electives, experiential learning projects, and leadership development. The Ignite Career Accelerator continues throughout the program to prepare graduates for immediate career impact.

learningMethods.name: Career Specializations
learningMethods.description: Students choose from over 20 career specializations starting in the first semester, with many linked to Centers of Expertise for focused, real-world learning.

schools.name: Mays Business School
schools.description: The Mays Business School Full-Time MBA at Texas A&M University offers an immersive two-year experience grounded in the Aggie Core Values of Excellence, Integrity, Leadership, Loyalty, Respect, and Selfless Service. The program combines a rigorous, data-driven curriculum with hands-on experiential learning, real-world company projects, and dedicated career coaching. Students can specialize in finance, supply chain, marketing, or data analytics while benefiting from one of the largest alumni networks in the world.

curriculum.year1: The first year focuses on core business fundamentals with an emphasis on data-driven decision making and analytical rigor. Students engage in leadership development grounded in the Aggie Core Values, with experiential learning through project-based courses and case competitions.
curriculum.year2: Second-year students choose a specialization in Finance, Supply Chain & Operations, Marketing, or Data Analytics to tailor their MBA experience. Advanced electives, capstone projects, and industry engagements deepen technical skills and leadership capabilities.

learningMethods.name: Experiential Learning Projects
learningMethods.description: Students engage in real-world projects, case studies, and company engagements that connect classroom learning to practical business scenarios.

schools.name: Smeal College of Business
schools.description: The Penn State Smeal College of Business offers a STEM-designated One-Year MBA that provides an immersive, customizable residential experience at the University Park campus. The program allows students to build a personalized learning plan and stack credentials in specialized areas such as accounting, business analytics, finance, real estate, and supply chain management. With a rolling admissions process, a global immersion component, and strong placement outcomes, Smeal offers exceptional value for both recent graduates and early-career professionals.

curriculum.year1: The 35-credit One-Year MBA program begins in August and concludes in May. The academic year consists of two semesters divided into four 7-week modules covering core business fundamentals. Students build a personalized learning plan and may stack credentials in accounting, business analytics, finance, real estate analysis and development, and supply chain management.

schools.description: The Robert H. Smith School of Business at the University of Maryland offers a Full-Time MBA that prepares students for high-impact careers in the dynamic Washington, D.C.–Baltimore corridor and beyond. The program combines rigorous academics with strong industry connections, a collaborative community, and 99% of the incoming class receiving financial awards. Located near the nation's capital, Smith provides unparalleled access to government agencies, consulting firms, technology companies, and global organizations.

curriculum.year1: The first year covers core business disciplines including finance, marketing, operations, strategy, and leadership. The curriculum integrates quantitative skills with strategic thinking, preparing students for summer internships in their target industries.
curriculum.year2: Second-year students customize their experience through specializations in areas including marketing, finance, information systems and business analytics, AI in business, supply chain management, and innovation and project management.

schools.name: Carlson School of Management
schools.description: The Carlson School of Management at the University of Minnesota offers a Full-Time MBA that combines academic rigor with the vibrant business community of the Twin Cities. The program produces highly skilled graduates who join leading companies across healthcare, consulting, financial services, and consumer goods. With 42% women and strong industry diversity, Carlson fosters an inclusive community situated amid 19 Fortune 500 companies including Target, UnitedHealth Group, and 3M.

curriculum.year1: The first year establishes a strong foundation in core business disciplines including finance, marketing, operations, strategy, and leadership. Students develop both technical expertise and management skills through a combination of case-based learning, team projects, and experiential coursework.
curriculum.year2: Second-year students deepen their expertise through electives and concentrations, engaging with Minneapolis-St. Paul's rich business ecosystem through consulting projects, company treks, and networking with local and national employers.
